title: Failed migration hook
brief: A release is blocked before its Deployment updates. Find the sync hook that failed.

checks.question: Which Application is blocked?
checks.hint: Check the environment label and sync status.
checks.why: The list tells you which release needs investigation.

checks.question: Which hook phase failed?
checks.hint: Read the failed Job entry in the operation panel.
checks.why: The operation panel shows which phase blocked the sync.

checks.question: What failure line does the migration Job print?
checks.hint: Open the failed Job's Logs tab.
checks.why: Hook logs give the immediate cause of a failed PreSync step.

truth.cause: A PreSync migration hook exits with an error
truth.fix: Repair the hook in git and resync
